svg.title: Clawd thinking
svg.desc: Ponders by candlelight, claw on chin and eyes on his thought cloud: he squints in concentration until the dots spark into a bulb, goes wide-eyed then sparkly, hops "eureka!" beaming, the idea pops, a new thought bubbles up as he switches claws, and a second, dud bulb dies to a half-lidded "hmm... no".
